scope: Remove continuous GPS history; retain live visibility and operational trip/event records

driver.permitted: Only the authenticated, active driver with a valid bound device/session can submit a fix; enrolled MFA remains enforced by the API session guard
driver.retries: An exact retry of the most recently accepted device sequence is acknowledged without repeating side effects; an older sequence is discardable out_of_order; reuse of the latest sequence with changed identity or payload is denied
driver.state: One private durable sequence cursor per device with IDs/timestamps/fingerprint only; movement validation uses the expiring latest live bus position per trip, including across replacement devices
driver.offline: Encrypted, ordered uploads are bounded to 24 hours; an ended/expired session cannot publish a live position; recovery cannot regress the latest live point
driver.failure: Invalid, impossible, stale, foreign, revoked and out-of-order submissions cannot advance the cursor or emit tracking changes

guardian.permitted: Latest authorized linked-student bus visibility and existing trip/event inbox categories only
guardian.denied: No raw tracking state, other students, another authority, historical coordinates or archive endpoints
guardian.failure: Stale/offline/unavailable visibility remains explicit; history removal does not grant additional scope or consent

schoolAuthorityAdmin.permitted: Authority-scoped live trip visibility, operational records and operational preservation with privileged MFA and recent authentication for preservation mutations
schoolAuthorityAdmin.denied: GPS archive listing, download, creation or replay

schoolScopedAdmin.permitted: Existing authorized school-scoped operations only; the retired school_admin role stays retired
schoolScopedAdmin.denied: Raw tracking state, GPS history, cross-school or cross-authority data and authority-wide preservation

transportationAdmin.permitted: Existing authority-scoped live operations and operational preservation with privileged MFA
transportationAdmin.denied: GPS archives, raw tracking state or cross-authority data

platformAdmin.permitted: Existing platform operational/retention aggregate administration with mandatory MFA
platformAdmin.denied: New tenant-coordinate access, private sequence state or GPS history exports

channels: Keep existing authorized coordinate-free live invalidations and operational notification categories; replayed/rejected fixes produce no new invalidation; no external notifications as QA
release: Block removal if any active preservation, GPS-specific hold, archive manifest or archive storage object exists; reconcile exact hosted definitions, rehearse with rollback, retain verified encrypted recovery, then human-reviewed protected release
